states: Embedded production build of this tree served by a mock-mode Pulse backend on pulse-dev (3 nodes), Chromium via the perf rig's browser package 1.62.1, logged in through /api/login.

Real /api/version and /api/security/status responses with only deploymentType and configuredButPendingRestart=true overridden, for deploymentType proxmoxve, systemd, docker, source and unset, at both viewports (10 cases).

Restart Required card renders one label plus an optional command for every type: proxmoxve 'Restart the service as root (older installs use pulse-backend): systemctl restart pulse'; systemd 'sudo systemctl restart pulse'; docker 'docker restart pulse'; source and unset show the generic 'Restart Pulse using your deployment method' with no command (previously source rendered an empty box).
No horizontal overflow in the instruction box in any case; desktop and 390px screenshots of the proxmoxve card inspected by eye.
interactions: Navigated to /settings/security-auth per case, waited for the 'How to restart Pulse:' heading, read the instruction box text and its scroll width, scrolled the card into view and captured it.
